notes.title: 20.03.27 Cubeland VR - New Mode Updated
notes.content:

Find and Join with other players!

notes.title: 20.03.11 Cubeland VR Minor Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Here are minor update news of Cubeland VR.
Now you can play more tension. Let's jump to the battle lines!

- Now large maps have dangerous red zone. It's a circular area that appears on the map.
  It Breaks everything and make game's pace faster!
- Tutorials in main menu.
- Turn with controller degrees reduced. (90 > 45) but speeds faster. 
- Teleport Blackout bug fixed.
- Faster teleport speed.
- Some minor bugs fixed.

And Discord server created. join and find other players!
[url=https://discord.gg/nHaWAu]Discord[/url]

Thanks!

notes.title: Cubeland VR v0.1 Out
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

New patch is out to bug fix for recent version.

- fix teleport control glitch issues. Add fade in-out effect on teleport.
- Players now can change the bomb`s weight in option.
- Spectator mod available when player down.
- Now all characters have their own unique effects.
- Many UI changed. HP bars, Bomb timer, Character selection menu etc.
- Goliath`s character model changed.

If you find some bugs after this patch, please post it on discussion page. :)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1171230/discussions/2/] Bug Reports! [/url]
